name: notify
description: A sound, a toast and a native notification when a long turn finishes or Claude waits for your approval

minSeconds.title: Only turns longer than (seconds)
minSeconds.description: Alert when a turn of the main conversation ends after at least this long. 0 alerts on every turn. Interrupted turns never alert.

onApproval.title: Alert when Claude waits for approval
onApproval.description: Alert when a tool call is put to you for approval, so a prompt left open in another window does not stall the session.

sound.title: Play a sound
sound.description: Play a short sound. Plays through afplay, so macOS only; elsewhere it does nothing.

toast.title: Show a toast
toast.description: Show a toast in the session.

native.title: Send a native notification
native.description: Raise a notification through your own notification channel, held for 10 seconds on surfaces that can hold it and dropped if you come back first. The terminal raises it at once.
